audit.cmd: git ls-files '*.yaml' '*.yml' | python -c "import sys,yaml;[list(yaml.safe_load_all(open(f.strip(),encoding='utf-8'))) for f in sys.stdin if f.strip()];print('yaml ok')"
git ls-files '*.js' '*.mjs' | grep -v node_modules | while read -r f; do node --check "$f" || exit 1; done; echo js ok
git ls-files '*.sh' | while read -r f; do bash -n "$f" || exit 1; done; echo sh ok
echo '{}' | node .claude/hooks/session-start.js >/dev/null && echo '{}' | node .claude/hooks/pre-compact-wiki-reminder.js >/dev/null && echo hooks ok
out=$(node .claude/factory/selftest.mjs 2>&1) && echo selftest ok || { printf '%s\n' "$out" | grep -E '^(FAIL|selftest)'; exit 1; }
